system.description:
When you **_declare that you know someone outside of Stonetop_**, someone who can help, name them and roll +CHA: **on a 10+**, yeah, they can help (tell us why they're willing); **on a 7-9**, they can help but pick 1 from the list below; **on a 6-**, the GM chooses 1 and then some.

- They still hold a grudge
- They're going to need something from you first
- They swore off this sort of thing long ago
- You can't exactly, y'know, trust them

success.value: Yeah, they can help (tell us why they're willing)

partial.value: They can help but pick 1 from the list below

failure.value: The GM chooses 1 from the list below and then some
